subject: Mum's visit tomorrow - can you send someone earlier?
body:
Hi Jordan,

Mum has a hospital appointment at 11am tomorrow that we only just found out about. Is there any way her carer could come at 8:30 instead of 10? She needs help getting ready and we can't get there in time.

Please let me know today if possible.

Thanks,
Priya

Sent from my iPhone

body:
